rows.text: The Company's previously provided full year GAAP net income remains estimated to be in the range of $73 million to $83 million and GAAP diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $2.89 to $3.29.

The Company's previously provided full year 2026 guidance of Adjusted EBITDA remains estimated to be in the range of $415 million to $435 million and adjusted diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $8.60 to $9.00.
